entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • C# 14 extension members compiler error CS1929 #82084

Closed

  • Smart break line doesn't insert object initializer for implicit object creation #80791
    Backlog
  • Analyzers crashing in 9.0.309 when used in msbuild #82010
  • An expected warning about an obsolete override is missing when overridden method is defined in a generic type. #81937
    18.4
  • Memory leak in ServiceHub.RoslynCodeAnalysisService.exe #81820
  • "Use coalesce expression" loses comments between variable declaration and if statement #82060
  • Remove ITypeSymbol extension APIs #80281
    18.4

Created

  • Do not restore from nuget.org during our build #82085

    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode

  • Update IOperation docs. #82083
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Collection Arguments

    Area-IDE, Next

  • Delete Solution.WithCachedSourceGeneratorState #82050
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Skip ngen log publishing when not applying optprof #82081
  • Keep comments when converting coalesce expressions #82062
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

  • Add Virtual Character System Specification document #82077
    Area-IDE
